prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference 1 is the original illustrated edition: extract and redraw ONLY its central illustration. Reference 2 is an approved standalone flat illustration and defines the required finish, cutout treatment, palette and ink texture. Make a straight-on 2D print illustration for a software edition, on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Use deep navy, pale citron and vivid orange with fine stippled printmaking texture. Remove the physical book/box completely: no software packaging, spine, cover rectangle, paper ground, title band, title or publisher text, logo, frame or ground shadow. The motif itself may retain illustrated object depth; the overall artwork must be flat front-facing printed artwork with no packaging perspective. Center the complete isolated motif with comfortable transparent margins, filling about 85% of the canvas. No lettering or numbers anywhere. Preserve opaque colored ink inside the motif, actual alpha outside and through clear gaps. Output PNG square 1024x1024. Motif: a desktop archive holder full of tabbed floppy disks with three loose overlapping floppy disks in front. Preserve the reference's cataloguing arrangement. Include restrained orange horizontal stripes behind the cluster, without any rectangular background.
